Q1: 2,6-Dichlorophenol exhibits internationally recognized significant hazards (Tier 1) for its acute and chronic environmental effects, dermal and eye exposure, and organ and systemic toxicity. It also presents an expanded perspective of potential endocrine disruption hazards (Tier 2) and demonstrated low/moderate oral hazards (Tier 3). However, data is insufficient (Tier 4) for confident assessment of its carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards, or inhalation hazards.
